rows: The President placard moves clockwise. The candidate nominates a Chancellor. The last elected President and Chancellor are barred. Everyone votes Ja! or Nein. A majority of Ja! elects the government.
The election tracker advances. After three failed votes the top policy is enacted with no power, and term limits are forgotten.
Ask every newly elected Chancellor whether they are Hitler. If so, the Fascists win.
The President draws three tiles and discards one. The Chancellor gets two, discards one and enacts the last. No talking. Reshuffle when fewer than three tiles remain.
If the new policy covered a power, the President uses it now.
After five Fascist policies, or for the next government only after No Confidence, the Chancellor may ask to veto. If the President agrees, both tiles are discarded and the tracker advances.
The President looks at one Party Membership card. Once per player.
The President picks the next presidential candidate. Then the order resumes.
The President looks at the top three tiles.
The President kills a player. If it is Hitler, the Liberals win.
The President and Chancellor look at one Party Membership card.
The Communists turn a Liberal into a Communist. Fascists cannot be radicalised.
Shuffle 2 Communist and 1 Liberal policy into the deck.
New Communists learn who the original Communists are.
The President executes a player, whose Party Membership card is revealed.
